source: Rajasthan Finance Department notifications (the inputs are offered on the Data page as transaction_cost_inputs.csv)

rates.applies_to: Conveyance duty, man or general buyer
rates.verbatim: reduced, with immediate effect, from 11 percent to 6 percent

rates.applies_to: Conveyance in favour of a woman not of SC, ST or BPL categories: clause (ii) of F.4(15)FD/Tax/2014-58 (14 Jul 2014) as amended
rates.verbatim: in clause (ii), for the existing expression "four percent", the expression "five percent" shall be substituted

rates.applies_to: Conveyance in favour of a woman of SC, ST or BPL categories: clause (i) of F.4(15)FD/Tax/2014-58 (14 Jul 2014) as amended
rates.verbatim: in clause (i), for the existing expression "three percent", the expression "four percent" shall be substituted

rates.applies_to: Conveyance in favour of a person with benchmark disabilities (supersedes F.4(15)FD/Tax/2014-59)
rates.verbatim: shall be reduced and charged at the rate of five percent

rates.applies_to: Sec 3-A surcharge, as a percentage of the stamp duty, on all instruments except those the Act's proviso charges at 10%
rates.verbatim: the surcharge at the rate of 13 percent shall be charged on the stamp duty payable on all the instruments

rates.applies_to: Sec 3-A surcharge on instruments of a value up to the threshold (the Act's proviso)
rates.verbatim: a proviso fixes 10% for instruments up to Rs 10 lakh

rates.applies_to: Sec 3-B surcharge, as a percentage of the stamp duty payable
rates.verbatim: Sec 3-B notified at 20% on the stamp duty payable

rates.applies_to: Registration fee, documents charged ad valorem (Article I), no maximum stated
rates.verbatim: 1% of the value or consideration whichever is higher

categories.label: Woman, not of SC, ST or BPL categories
Woman of SC, ST or BPL categories

caveat: Worked from the Finance Department's notifications, read in November 2026. A later amendment has not been ruled out. Concessions reported for joint purchase by a couple and for some flats, which I have not confirmed, would lower the total and are not included. Lease, regularisation and loan documents are charged differently and are not covered.
